title: Feature page

sub_fields.label: Breadcrumb label
sub_fields.name: crumb
sub_fields.instructions: Last breadcrumb item, for example Billing & counter.

sub_fields.label: Breadcrumb parent
sub_fields.name: parent
sub_fields.instructions: Middle breadcrumb item (plain text), for example Features.

sub_fields.label: Eyebrow
sub_fields.name: eyebrow
sub_fields.instructions: Small label above the heading. Optional.

sub_fields.label: Heading (H1)
sub_fields.name: h1
sub_fields.instructions: Empty uses the page title.

sub_fields.label: Meta line
sub_fields.name: meta
sub_fields.instructions: Small line under the lead, for example Last updated: [date]. Optional.

sub_fields.label: Background pattern
sub_fields.name: pattern
sub_fields.instructions: Faint blister-pack dots behind the hero. "Site setting" uses the inner-page hero pattern switch in Site settings.

fields.label: Start free button label
fields.name: cta_free
fields.instructions: Empty shows "Start free". Links to the app sign-up URL.

fields.label: Reassurance lines
fields.name: assure
fields.instructions: Check-marked lines under the buttons. Shortcodes keep plan names live.

fields.label: Product screen
fields.name: screen
fields.instructions: Sample screen under the buttons (theme file in assets/img/screens/).

sub_fields.label: Intro
sub_fields.name: intro
sub_fields.instructions: Optional.

sub_fields.label: When
sub_fields.name: time
sub_fields.instructions: For example 7:45 pm, five people waiting.

sub_fields.label: Cost
sub_fields.name: cost
sub_fields.instructions: Shown after "Cost". The first letter is capitalised.

sub_fields.label: Intro
sub_fields.name: intro
sub_fields.instructions: Optional.

sub_fields.label: Leak
sub_fields.name: leak
sub_fields.instructions: Card heading.

sub_fields.label: How it’s plugged
sub_fields.name: plug_html
sub_fields.instructions: HTML allowed (for example bold text and links). Shortcodes such as [rx_plan] and [rx_link] keep live values live.

sub_fields.label: Feature (API)
sub_fields.name: feat
sub_fields.instructions: Pricing API feature unique_name, for example feat_csv_import. The plan name then comes live from the API.

sub_fields.label: Plan (fixed text)
sub_fields.name: plan
sub_fields.instructions: Fixed plan text, used when Feature is empty or not listed by the API, for example Every plan. Both empty shows "Plan: not listed separately".

fields.label: Worked example
fields.name: leaks_example
fields.instructions: Last card of the register. Illustrative numbers, kept as text.

sub_fields.label: Title
sub_fields.name: title
sub_fields.instructions: Empty shows the demo card ("Go through these with your own stock") instead of a worked example.

sub_fields.label: Lines
sub_fields.name: lines
sub_fields.instructions: Auto puts × before every line except the first.

fields.label: Expiry loss estimator
fields.name: leaks_estimator
fields.instructions: Also loads the estimator styles on this page.
fields.message: Show the expiry loss estimator under the register

fields.instructions: The item count is shown on the checklist automatically.

fields.name: related
fields.instructions: Shown in the order chosen. Labels and descriptions come from the Features menu. A "Switching from other software" link is always added last.

sub_fields.label: Answer
sub_fields.name: a_html

sub_fields.label: Confirmed
sub_fields.name: confirmed
sub_fields.instructions: Off marks the item for review (?review) and keeps it out of the FAQ schema.

description: Every section of a feature page: hero, buttons and screen, scenes, leak register, steps, capabilities, guide, demo checklist, related pages and FAQ (replaces the $fp array of features/*.php).
